advice.title: Calibrate the probe
advice.detail: Readings are raw millivolts (1197 mV now) until both ends of the scale are known, and no percentage or watering advice can be given. With the probe out of the pot and wiped dry, open /api/calibrate?point=dry. Then water the pot, let it drain for an hour, push the probe back in and open /api/calibrate?point=wet.

advice.title: Clock not set - seasonal advice suspended
advice.detail: SNTP has not synced, so the feeding, pruning and repotting rules have no date to work from and are held back. Everything measured on this page is still valid; only the calendar is missing.

advice.title: Current state
advice.detail: Soil 1197 mV, uncalibrated, watered never. 0.0 h of history retained. Watering is detected automatically from the step in the reading; log one by hand with /api/ack?task=water if you water with the probe out.
